status: Exploratory development analysis, not independent confirmation or a causal experiment
sensitivities: primary with box quality ok only
matching: Maximum-cardinality disjoint matching, then minimum normalized descriptor distance. Exposure and requested generation parameters do not enter matching.
numerics: Three largest-exposure-gap pairs and three closest-descriptor pairs not already chosen; 2048, 8192, 16384 rays plus a fixed rotation at 8192 rays. These are diagnostic examples, not an unbiased numerical-error sample.
comparison: Paired signed exposure differences: zero prediction, basic-descriptor ridge, expanded-descriptor ridge; outer 5-fold or fewer by pair count; inner regularization selection. Each pair stays together.
interpretation: Matches are on finite-scale estimated descriptors. Residual mismatch and descriptor measurement limitations preclude claiming identical physical morphology. No GNN training in this stage.
